messages:
Ravi: Heads-up
I'm drafting a compact manager checklist for Taylor (start Mon 2025-06-02). Want something managers can follow without hunting docs. Posting proposed micro-checklist + templates. Please add gaps.

Ravi: MICRO-CHECKLIST (manager view) 
- Pre-start (48-72h): confirm hardware + account provisioning; share team slack + org chart; add to payroll list.
- Day 0 (before 9am): confirm laptop delivered + MDM enrolled; confirm email + GitHub access.
- Day 1: 15m quick team roll-call; 45m role expectations + 1:1; pair with buddy 2h to get dev env running.
- Day 2: Access & security walkthru (who signs off prod access); invite to weekly infra & sprint syncs.
- Day 3-5: Assign two small shipable tasks (one docs, one code), and a learning doc to review.
- End of week 1: manager shares initial 30/60/90 draft; schedule 30min goal review.
- Ongoing: log any blockers in #onboarding-blockers and tag @eng-infra or @security.

Nora: Love the brevity. A couple things: add a line about "confirm 2FA + company SSO setup" and "request necessary vendor access (e.g., Sentry, Datadog)". Also who owns ID badge?

Elena: Security can own vendor access request list. For badge: Facilities owns it but manager should confirm shipping. I'll add a quick checklist item: "Facilities: badge request submitted by Day 0".

Sam: I'm happy to be buddy. I'll do Day 1 dev pairing and the PR walkthrough. I can create the sample PR task in the onboarding board. Also recommend daily 20m check-ins for first 3 days.

Ravi: Good call on 2FA/SSO. Update checklist with that. Also adding a standardized 1:1 kickoff blurb managers can copy into invites:
```
Subject: Welcome Taylor  1:1 Kickoff
When: Mon 10:00 AM (30m)
Agenda: intros, role context, top 3 priorities, 30/60/90 expectations, Qs
```
Use this text as the meeting description.

OnboardBot: Reminder: All new hire paperwork (tax forms, NDA, employee handbook) must be completed 48 hours prior to start. HR contact: hr@redwood.com

Nora: For 30/60/90 guidance, I recommend managers set one measurable onboarding success metric per window: 
- 30 days: dev env + test suite passing; 1st small PR merged.
- 60 days: independently handle day-to-day tickets; own one feature area doc.
- 90 days: lead a small project or take handoff of a module.
Make sure these are written and shared with the hire.

Elena: Security note: any request for prod-level credentials needs a ticket in IAM with manager approval. Managers should not grant elevated access ad-hoc.

Sam: I'll add the dev-env checklist to the onboarding doc and include troubleshooting steps: VPN -> MDM -> SSH keys -> local test runner.

Ravi: Also adding a quick escalation path for managers: 
- Blocker: post in #onboarding-blockers + tag @eng-infra and @people-ops.
- Security credential request: open IAM ticket and cc security@redwood.com.
- Hardware failure: create facilities ticket referencing order ID.

Nora: Can someone draft the calendar invites? I'll take onboarding week events (team intro, shadow sessions). Ravi — want to handle the 1:1 kickoff?

Ravi: I'll send the 1:1 kickoff invite once hardware confirmed. Nora please create recurring "onboarding sync" events for the week and assign Sam as host.

OnboardBot: New hire welcome kit emailed to taylor@example.com. Badge request link: https://redwood.internal/facilities/badge-request

Elena: I'll prepare the vendor access list and post it here by EOD Thursday.

Sam: Created onboarding board with 5 starter tasks and assigned the sample PR to Taylor (status: backlog). Invites sent for daily 20m check-ins Mon-Wed.

Ravi: Final note for managers: write 3 tangible objectives per 30/60/90 (product, infra, collaboration). We'll review at end of week 1 and adjust. If no objections, this will be the official playbook for Taylor.

Nora: No objections from me. :thumbsup:

Elena: Sounds good.

OnboardBot: Action items summary: hardware owner = Facilities/Keiko; buddy = Sam; 30/60/90 draft due by EOW; security vendor list by Elena.
